raw_payload.what_happens: The camera tracks Lakhā, his eyes wide with desperation, as he walks across the expansive marble courtyard of the Sheth’s mansion. He lowers himself in a deep bow before the imposing patriarch, gripping a weather‑worn satchel. Distant temple bells ring in the background, amplifying his urgent plea for a loan to rescue his family.
